text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer identifies what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in one image. These technologies have many applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise road signs, detect pedestrians, and avoid accidents. Doctors also use it to study medical images. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more useful in many industries.
